summary: The change distinguishes same-day passkeys with a visible localized time and gives each remove control an accessible name containing the credential type and formatted timestamp, while retaining the existing compact row layout.

evidence: public/auth.js lines 594-598 counts credentials by local calendar day, and lines 624-629 switch same-day entries to a visible date and short time.
public/auth.js lines 637-640 include the credential name and formatted timestamp in each remove button's aria-label.
The existing row layout keeps timestamp text in the minmax(0,1fr) details column at public/styles.css lines 432-463, allowing wrapping within the compact mobile grid.
